body:
First independently raised 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrences unknown.

Affected [PR #1334](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1334), exact merge `e9190786dbf758524a3bde513fc4bb4d1ed6a3e7`, head `0ea0b5524392aa7ad98d2f2f66b80e8ef1976376`. Preserve closed original #1322 and its one-PR source-fitness history. This new bounded remainder owns only the disjoint namespace below, at most two PRs. Existing #1315/#1314/#1133 Russia count/source work and regional owners remain separate; no implementation claim is taken.

Confirmed control defect: `assessment_controls.py` trusts stale comparison/receipt strings without reading actual run-two products or verifying either whole output manifest against products. Its contact check trusts `contact_count:41` without checking the contact array or identities. `check_closure` uses a family ID set without checking family uniqueness/count, so a duplicate empty family passes. A source-ID negative control constructs a changed digest and deliberately raises its own ValueError; it does not exercise the source comparison/consumed source reader. Finally all three control outputs use overwrite-capable `write_text`, with no complete fresh output admission or symlink safeguards.

Actual reproduction: in a managed detached exact-merge review slot, copy the unchanged `assessment_controls.py`, complete handoff and every complete retained execution artifact into a private packet mirror. Invoke the real script using Python3.12.14 `-I`, without credentials. Keep original receipt/comparison strings intact for these controlled mutations; they are precisely the stale evidence that should fail against actual bytes.

- Two intact fresh fixtures exit0 and reproduce all three original control receipts exactly.
- Change a real row's `water_status` in complete `executions/run-2/candidate-assessment.jsonl` to an unmistakably invalid controlled value. Exit0; reproducibility is still passed with unchanged original digest strings, without inspecting the altered run-two bytes.
- Remove one complete contact record from run-one `contact-lineage.json`, keeping its asserted count41. Actual array length40; exit0 with reported positive contacts41.
- Append a duplicate of an existing run-one family record with its `candidate_ids` replaced by an empty array, preserving asserted family_count19 and all52 memberships. Actual20 families with a duplicate identity; exit0 and the passed positive receipt even reports families20.
- Replace the private `executions/reproducibility-control.json` with a dangling symlink to an absent file in your own scratch outside the packet. Exit0; target created and passed receipt written outside the packet.
- Put an ordinary `original-sentinel` file at that control output path. Exit0; sentinel is overwritten. Never aim these checks at originals, another worker or production.

The original retained scientific result is not alleged to have those mutations. These independently exercised actual entrypoint failures show that the advertised controls cannot validate complete repeat-run/scope custody or safely regenerate evidence.

Success criteria:

1. Preserve all206 original files/modes, all original scientific source/input/output bytes and hashes, five failed/interrupted attempts, dates, closed #1322, source IDs and unknowns. New code/evidence only under the new owned prefix. Preserve all52 candidates,19 complete families,41 complete contacts and28/24 source-relative classifications. Do not rewrite earlier evidence or promote geography authority.
2. Consume and authenticate the actual complete run-one AND run-two products, manifests and recorded executed-code/input closure. Recompute hashes/lengths, require complete expected product sets and compare actual whole outputs. Stale success strings or missing artifacts cannot create a passed repeatability receipt.
3. Derive expected52/19/41 rosters from the original pinned complete handoff and scope; check actual unique identities, full contact records, exact family memberships and counts. Reject missing/duplicate/foreign/rebound IDs and coherent contradictory summaries even when candidate hashes are refreshed. Exercise real source-ID comparison/reader behavior with an admitted complete native fixture; do not use a deliberately thrown exception as an experiment. Record the full external RUS comparison unexecuted if complete admission remains unavailable.
4. Admit the entire fresh three-control output set and ancestors before mutation. Reject ordinary occupied paths, directories, live/dangling symlinks, unsafe ancestors and escaped destinations. Use exclusive creation, preserve sentinels/targets on late/partial-write failures, and publish the complete receipt last. Actual producer output admission is an adjacent source-inspected concern; do not claim that full producer has been independently run here.
5. Exercise the real new control CLI twice with complete original reports. Independent controls must cover altered/missing run-two products, false comparison strings, wrong manifest hashes, contact omission/duplicate/rebinding, duplicated/foreign family identities, source identity drift, occupied ordinary/live/broken/ancestor/escaped paths and partial-write failures. Results must describe actual experiments and remaining limits, not synthetic booleans. No new oversized global scientific generation is required merely to repair retained-result controls.

Positive evidence: all206 whole originals match head/merge,223,672,806 encoded bytes (183,506,032 unique raw bytes). All173 packet input pins,205 encoded manifest descriptors and six whole baseline pins authenticated. Complete preparation body equals original acceptance hash `2c6cae9dbf4ac28bfe623624a5eab92dcc70ca71d6decc36f6ec8ca204d4d550`. Every retained candidate feature/geometry/route/family hash and class matches that full preparation. All41 full contacts equal their complete Atlas part records and ordinals. Both original four-product runs and their actual output manifests match. Independently examined complete KAZ full174 and simplified174 native ID sets, and complete RUS simplified2327; expected digests match. Seven scalar metric bindings agree. No allegation that original28/24 classifications or source count uncertainty were resolved incorrectly.

Deduplication: complete authenticated all-state pagination exhausted15 pages (14x100+90 entries). Original1322 and parent1202 inspected; no existing repair covers this packet/control writer. Complete scoped path history contains only this PR; all three current open PR file lists exhausted. Other country repairs and Russian provenance/count jobs remain separately owned. Initially blocked pending shared complete readiness/dependency/ownership review.

Limits: manifest declares1,114,685,054 unique raw+decoded bytes; whole assembled route components/families/admin bodies are208,391,779/111,223,285/68,041,008 bytes. The full external Russian source is120,489,189 bytes. These exceed256MiB phase /32MiB whole-file bounds. Full producer and full RUS source comparison were not executed; no fragment/streaming/stage waiver was used. Original physical calculations, finite contemporary legal/physical evidence, source rights/date interpretation and current boundaries remain unverified. PR1334 stays Incomplete. Fixing controls will be separately audited and will not retroactively certify unexecuted science.
